title: CAN Log
text: Log received CAN messages, 1 input; {File name} sets the log file location, {Variable name}, {Maximum number of messages to log} limits quantity of messages, {Log messages from} sets the source of messages, {Device} sets the cAN device and channel and {Sample time} sets the block sampling time in simulation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CAN Msg
ports.summary: CAN messages to log CAN_MESSAGE | CAN_MESSAGE_BUS

params.name: File name
params.values: Log file location and name untitled.mat (default) | file name

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Variable name for CAN message in log file ans (default) | variable name

params.name: Maximum number of messages to log
Log messages from
params.values: Source of messages CAN Bus (default) | Input port

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel list option

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Block sampling time in simulation 0.01 (default) | numeric
